Earlier this year, we learned that Volvo plans to update CarPlay to support Apple Music spatial audio and other features. Today, Volvo confirmed its support again and announced availability details for this audio upgrade.

In January of this year, Volvo pledged to continue supporting Apple CarPlay, even as some automakers like GM reduced support in certain models. At the time, we also reported that the Volvo EX60 would support spatial audio through CarPlay.

Today, Volvo announced new details about its spatial audio feature, specifically for the EX90:

The latest software update also brings spatial audio support with CarPlay* to the Volvo EX90, featuring Dolby Atmos technology. Through the Bowers & Wilkins premium audio system equipped with 25 high-performance speakers, drivers can enjoy a multidimensional, immersive sound experience, with music and vocals enveloping the entire cabin.

Volvo added: "Spatial audio on CarPlay requires the Bowers & Wilkins sound system for the full immersive experience, which is available as an upgrade when ordering the Volvo EX60, EX90, and ES90."

Not planning to buy a new car? Earlier this year, Pioneer launched the first aftermarket CarPlay system to support Dolby Atmos spatial audio playback.
